# Homelab — GitHub Copilot Instructions

The canonical instructions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repo root — project overview, conventions, and the README update rule. Read it before
making changes.

Detailed, path-specific checklists apply automatically (via `applyTo`) when you edit:

- `terraform/**` → `.github/instructions/terraform.instructions.md`
- `ansible/**` → `.github/instructions/ansible.instructions.md`
